send_boneio_autodiscovery.markdownDescription:
Enable sending BoneIO autodiscovery messages

When enabled, this device publishes its outputs, covers, inputs, and sensors
to MQTT discovery topics (boneio/{device_id}/discovery/*) so other BoneIO
devices can discover and control it.
send_boneio_autodiscovery.title: Send boneio autodiscovery

receive_boneio_autodiscovery.markdownDescription:
Enable receiving BoneIO autodiscovery messages

When enabled, this device subscribes to BoneIO autodiscovery topics
(boneio/+/discovery/#) and automatically discovers neighboring BoneIO devices.
receive_boneio_autodiscovery.title: Receive boneio autodiscovery

update_channel.markdownDescription:

update_channel.title: Update channel

ca_certs.title: Ca certs

certfile.title: Certfile

keyfile.title: Keyfile

insecure.markdownDescription:
Skip checking the broker's certificate

Encrypts the connection without checking who is on the other end.
Anyone able to intercept it can pose as the broker and read the
password. Only for testing.
insecure.title: Insecure

tls.description: Encrypt the connection to the broker (TLS)
tls.markdownDescription:
Encrypt the connection to the broker (TLS)

Connect to the broker over TLS, usually on port 8883. Without ca_certs
the broker's certificate is checked against the system's trusted
authorities, which is right for a public one; for your own CA, point
ca_certs at its certificate. Relative paths are resolved from the
directory holding config.yaml. If TLS is on and cannot be set up,
boneIO does not connect at all rather than fall back to plain text.
tls.title: Tls
